LESSON: HOLDING TOOLS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.1: Holding Tools

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Holding Tools. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Holding Tools
2. Practise Holding Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Holding Tools

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Holding Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Holding Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Holding Tools at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Holding Tools at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Holding Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Holding Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Holding Tools using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Holding Tools in the examples.
2. Explain Holding Tools to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Holding Tools.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Holding Tools using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Holding Tools important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Holding Tools
2. Practise Holding Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Holding Tools

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
